destinations.name: Goa
destinations.short_description: Discover Goa with our tours. Sun-kissed beaches, UNESCO Portuguese cathedrals, spice plantations, and serene river cruises.
destinations.intro_heading: Golden Beaches, Baroque Cathedrals & Vibrant Coastlines
destinations.intro_content:
Goa is India’s most celebrated coastal haven, blessed with sun-drenched Arabian Sea beaches, UNESCO World Heritage Baroque churches of Old Goa, spice plantations, and historic Portuguese mansions.

Offering a unique fusion of Indian hospitality and European charm, Goa provides unforgettable beachside relaxation, heritage walks, river cruises, and flavorful coastal dining.

sections.title: Best Time to Visit Goa
sections.content: November to March is the peak season with sunny tropical skies, warm waters, and vibrant beach shacks, while June to September offers lush green landscapes and tranquil romantic monsoon getaways.

sections.title: Comfortable Private Sightseeing
sections.content: Explore North and South Goa in comfort with private air-conditioned vehicles, tailored for hassle-free sightseeing across historic forts, pristine beaches, spice plantations, and Portuguese quarters.

sections.title: Beaches & Coastal Experiences
sections.content: Relax on sun-kissed golden sand beaches from lively Baga and Calangute to serene South Goa havens like Palolem and Morjim, enjoy thrilling watersports, and take sunset cruises along the Mandovi River.

sections.title: Cultural & Heritage Experiences
sections.content: Discover Goa’s rich Indo-Portuguese heritage with visits to the UNESCO Baroque churches of Old Goa including Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral, historic Fort Aguada, and the colorful Latin Quarter of Fontainhas.

sections.title: Flexible Tours Across All Seasons
sections.content: Goa offers versatile travel opportunities throughout the year, from vibrant winter beach holidays and heritage sightseeing to peaceful off-season wellness retreats and spice plantation excursions.

faqs.question: Best Time to Visit Goa
faqs.answer: November to March is the peak season with sunny skies, warm tropical waters, and vibrant seaside cafe culture.

faqs.question: Old Goa & UNESCO Baroque Churches
faqs.answer: Visit the Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral, showcasing magnificent 16th-century Portuguese architecture and sacred art.

faqs.question: Spice Plantations & Mandovi River Cruises
faqs.answer: Take an aromatic walking tour through organic spice plantations followed by private sunset cruises along the Mandovi River.

faqs.question: Private Chauffeur Coastal Explorations
faqs.answer: Travel in sanitized luxury private vehicles to explore hidden beaches in South Goa, historic forts like Fort Aguada and Chapora, and traditional Latin Quarter villas.

destinations.name: Karnataka
destinations.short_description: Discover Karnataka with our tours. Regal palaces of Mysore, UNESCO ruins of Hampi, lush coffee estates in Coorg, and rich wildlife sanctuaries.
destinations.intro_heading: Royal Palaces, Ancient Hampi & Coffee Mist Hills
destinations.intro_content:
Karnataka is a mesmerizing land of royal opulence and UNESCO architectural treasures. Home to the legendary Vijayanagara Empire capital of Hampi, the stone-carved temples of Belur and Halebidu, the regal Mysore Palace, and aromatic coffee hills of Coorg and Chikmagalur.

Karnataka seamlessly bridges historic grandeur with lush wildlife national parks and vibrant cultural life. Experience royal heritage, wildlife safaris in Bandipur and Nagarhole, and breathtaking waterfalls cascading down the Western Ghats.

sections.title: Best Time to Visit Karnataka
sections.content: October to April provides the most pleasant and dry weather for exploring the UNESCO ruins of Hampi, the regal palaces of Mysore, wildlife safaris, and the cool coffee hills of Coorg.

sections.title: Comfortable Private Sightseeing
sections.content: Discover Karnataka with private sanitized chauffeur-driven vehicles, ensuring comfortable travel across historic temple circuits, royal heritage cities, wildlife reserves, and scenic Western Ghats destinations.

sections.title: Heritage & Historical Experiences
sections.content: Marvel at the illuminated grandeur of Mysore Palace, walk through the ancient boulder-strewn monuments of the Vijayanagara Empire in Hampi, and admire the stone carvings of Belur and Halebidu.

sections.title: Nature & Wildlife Experiences
sections.content: Embark on thrilling Jeep safaris in Nagarhole and Bandipur National Parks to spot wild tigers and Asian elephants, and stay in serene coffee estate homestays amidst the misty hills of Coorg and Chikmagalur.

sections.title: Flexible Tours Across All Seasons
sections.content: Karnataka offers varied travel experiences in every season, from winter heritage tours and wildlife expeditions to lush monsoon waterfall journeys and year-round coffee plantation retreats.

faqs.question: Best Time to Visit Karnataka
faqs.answer: October to April provides cool, sunny weather perfect for exploring the rock-cut monuments of Hampi, Mysore Palace festivities, and wildlife safaris.

faqs.question: Royal Heritage & Architectural Wonders
faqs.answer: Marvel at the illuminated Mysore Palace, explore the boulder-strewn ruins of the UNESCO Vijayanagara Empire in Hampi, and study the intricate Hoysala temple carvings.

faqs.question: Coffee Plantations & Nature Escapes
faqs.answer: Immerse yourself in lush coffee and spice estates in Coorg and Chikmagalur, staying in luxury plantation bungalows with private nature walks.

faqs.question: Wildlife Safaris & Nature Sanctuaries
faqs.answer: Embark on private guided Jeep safaris in Kabini and Bandipur Tiger Reserve to encounter wild Bengal tigers, leopards, and herds of Asian elephants.

destinations.name: Kerala
destinations.short_description: Discover Kerala with our tours. Tranquil emerald backwaters, tea plantation hills in Munnar, Ayurvedic wellness, and tropical beaches.
destinations.intro_heading: Enchanting Palm Groves, Spice Hills & Serene Waters
destinations.intro_label: God’s Own Country — Nature, Backwaters & Wellness
destinations.intro_content:
Kerala is a tropical paradise acclaimed worldwide for its tranquil emerald backwaters, misty Western Ghat hill stations, pristine Arabian Sea coastlines, and ancient Ayurvedic healing traditions.

Flourishing through centuries of spice trade with Arab, Roman, and European mariners, Kerala offers an exquisite tapestry of Kathakali dance, temple festivals, tea plantations, and backwater houseboats. From the rolling hills of Munnar to the palm-fringed canals of Alleppey and the vibrant spice markets of Fort Kochi, Kerala offers a serene rejuvenation of mind, body, and soul.

sections.title: Best Time to Visit Kerala
sections.content: The ideal season to explore Kerala is between September and March for cool, pleasant backwater cruises and sightseeing, while June to August offers the best climate for traditional Ayurvedic wellness therapies and lush monsoon landscapes.

sections.title: Comfortable Private Sightseeing
sections.content: Travel effortlessly across Kerala in private, air-conditioned chauffeur-driven vehicles with dedicated local driver-guides, providing seamless transfers between Kochi, Munnar, Thekkady, Alleppey, and Kovalam.

sections.title: Backwaters & Nature Experiences
sections.content: Cruise along tranquil palm-fringed backwaters aboard authentic luxury houseboats in Alleppey and Kumarakom, walk through fragrant tea and spice plantations in Munnar, and explore Periyar Lake wildlife sanctuaries.

sections.title: Cultural & Heritage Experiences
sections.content: Immerse yourself in Kerala’s rich living heritage with live Kathakali dance dramas, Kalaripayattu martial arts, historic colonial architecture in Fort Kochi, and vibrant temple festivals.

sections.title: Flexible Tours Across All Seasons
sections.content: Kerala tours are customizable for every season, offering relaxing backwater retreats, high-altitude hill station escapes, tropical beach getaways, and holistic Ayurvedic rejuvenation all year round.

faqs.question: Best Time to Visit Kerala
faqs.answer: The ideal season to explore Kerala is between September and March for cool pleasant backwater cruises, and June to August for authentic monsoon Ayurvedic wellness therapies.

faqs.question: Private Houseboat & Chauffeur Safaris
faqs.answer: Sail along serene backwaters in luxury air-conditioned houseboats with private chef and dedicated guide, complemented by private transfers across tea estates and coastal sanctuaries.

faqs.question: Spice Trails & Wildlife Safaris
faqs.answer: Walk through fragrant cardamom, pepper, and vanilla plantations in Thekkady, and cruise Lake Periyar to view wild elephants, exotic birds, and tropical flora in their natural habitat.

faqs.question: Holistic Ayurveda & Classical Arts
faqs.answer: Experience time-honored Ayurvedic rejuvenation treatments, witness dramatic Kathakali dance performances, and discover Kalaripayattu martial art demonstrations.

destinations.name: Tamil Nadu
destinations.hero_subtitle: Discover Tamil Nadu with our tours.
destinations.short_description: Discover Tamil Nadu with our tours. Explore ancient Dravidian temples, UNESCO heritage monuments, hill stations, and vibrant cultural arts.
destinations.intro_heading: History of the Land of Temples & Timeless Culture
destinations.intro_label: Tamil Nadu is ancient, Tamil Nadu is eternal
destinations.intro_content:
Tamil Nadu is one of the world’s oldest living civilizations, with a history that stretches back over 5,000 years. Renowned for its classical heritage, the region flourished under powerful dynasties such as the Cholas, Cheras, Pandyas, Pallavas, and Vijayanagara rulers, who shaped South India through monumental architecture, literature, trade, and spiritual traditions.

The state is celebrated as the Land of Temples, home to magnificent Dravidian marvels like Brihadeeswarar Temple, Meenakshi Amman Temple, Shore Temple, and Ekambareswarar Temple. Beyond architecture, Tamil Nadu is the birthplace of Tamil language, one of the oldest classical languages in the world, and a vibrant center for Bharatanatyam, Carnatic music, silk weaving, bronze sculptures, and spiritual philosophy. Today, Tamil Nadu seamlessly blends ancient traditions with modern life, offering travelers a deeply enriching cultural journey.

sections.title: Best Time to Visit Tamil Nadu
sections.content: Tamil Nadu can be explored throughout the year, but the most pleasant season is from October to March, when the climate is ideal for temple visits, heritage walks, hill stations, and coastal sightseeing.

sections.title: Comfortable Private Sightseeing
sections.content: Explore Tamil Nadu comfortably with private, chauffeur-driven vehicles designed for flexible sightseeing across temples, heritage landmarks, cities, hill stations, and coastal destinations.

sections.title: Cultural & Heritage Experiences

sections.title: Flexible Tours Across All Seasons
sections.content: Tamil Nadu offers flexible travel experiences throughout the year, allowing travelers to combine cultural heritage, temple visits, beaches, hill stations, wildlife, and local experiences according to the season.

faqs.answer: Tamil Nadu can be explored throughout the year, but the most pleasant season is from October to March, when the climate is ideal for temple visits, heritage walks, hill stations, and coastal sightseeing.

tours.title: Mahabalipuram Day Tour
tours.short_description: Step back in time with our Mahabalipuram Day Tour, exploring one of Tamil Nadu's most iconic heritage destinations.
tours.overview:
Step back in time with our Mahabalipuram Day Tour, exploring one of Tamil Nadu's most iconic heritage destinations. Also known as Mamallapuram, this ancient port town dates back to the 7th–9th century Pallava dynasty and is renowned for its rock-cut monuments and UNESCO World Heritage Sites carved entirely from granite.

This tour offers a perfect blend of history, architecture, spirituality, and coastal beauty, making it ideal for culture lovers, history enthusiasts, and families.

tours.overview:
PALMLEAF HOROSCOPE (FIND YOUR DESTINY)

Nadi, in the ancient language of Tamil, means “in search of”. Because an individual goes in search of the predictions made for them, to find purpose and direction, the entire system of the Maharishis’ insights and predictions eventually came to be called by this name, Nadi Astrology.

Three thousand years ago, personal information about you was dictated by the Maharishis to their disciples and handwritten on special Palm Leaves, also called Nadis. These Palm Leaves were preserved for all this time, for you to access their contents when you need it most. Your Palm Leaf was written specifically for you, to provide you with guidance during the most important times of your life, by allowing you to prepare for future life changing events.

If you are approaching this crossroad in your life, then your Palm Leaf begins to draw you upon the search for its contents.

📜 Procedures for Palm Leaf Reading

1. Searching for bundle(s)

As soon as we get the appointment, we use your thumb impression, including in which country you were born in, the search will commence. Our expert readers in India will physically search for your Palm Leaf bundle(s), which might contain your individual Palm Leaf.

2. Matching

Preparation for the matching process by moderator; Once the reader has found your bundle(s) that might contain your Palm Leaf, the matching process and thus the search for your one personal Palm Leaf within the bundle(s) begins.

3. Reading

The reading is the most important part of your experience. Based on your individual Palm Leaf, which was identified during the preceding matching process, this final part will let you know about your life.

faqs.question: What does Nadi mean and what is Nadi Astrology?
faqs.answer: Nadi, in the ancient language of Tamil, means “in search of”. Because an individual goes in search of the predictions made for them, to find purpose and direction, the entire system of the Maharishis’ insights and predictions eventually came to be called by this name, Nadi Astrology.

faqs.question: How were the Palm Leaves prepared and preserved?
faqs.answer: Three thousand years ago, personal information about you was dictated by the Maharishis to their disciples and handwritten on special Palm Leaves, also called Nadis. These Palm Leaves were preserved for all this time, for you to access their contents when you need it most.

faqs.question: What are the procedures for palm leaf reading?
faqs.answer: 1. Searching for bundle(s): we use your thumb impression and country of birth to search for candidate bundles. 2. Matching: moderated verification to identify your one personal leaf. 3. Reading: the reading lets you know about your life and future milestones.

faqs.question: What are the opening times?
faqs.answer: Opening Times: Every Day from 10 AM to 6 PM.

faqs.question: What are the prices and what is included?

pages.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
pages.subtitle: Transparent terms for booking confirmations, cancellation procedures, refund eligibility, timelines, and tour rescheduling.
pages.content:
At Wonderer South India, we understand that travel plans may change unexpectedly.

This Refund & Cancellation Policy outlines the exact terms under which cancellations, refunds, and rescheduling are handled. Please review this policy carefully before confirming your reservations.

01

Booking Confirmation & Advance Payment

  • All tour packages and travel bookings are officially confirmed only after receipt of the required advance payment.
  • Official booking confirmation vouchers will be dispatched via email or WhatsApp containing complete itinerary specifics.
  • Any service, entrance pass, or detour not explicitly mentioned in the confirmed itinerary voucher will be treated as an additional chargeable service.
02

Cancellation Policy & Notification

  • All cancellation requests must be submitted in writing via official email to contact@tramaxtours.in or through our verified Contact Us page.
  • The timestamp on which the written cancellation request is officially received will be registered as the official cancellation date.
  • Cancellation charges vary according to provider deadlines (partner hotels, airlines, heritage transport operators, etc.).
03

Refund Eligibility & Conditions

Refunds, if applicable, are subject to the individual terms and contractual cancellation policies of our third-party service partners. Wonderer South India acts as a professional intermediary and coordinates with vendors to maximize refund recovery.

✅ Refunds May Be Applicable Under:

  • Cancellations submitted within the permitted advance time frame as stipulated in your specific package voucher.
  • Non-availability or cancellation of a confirmed service due to internal reasons beyond the customer's control.
  • Verified duplicate transactions or overpayments (reimbursed in full after audit).
04

Non-Refundable Situations

⚠️ Strictly Non-Refundable Cases:

  • Last-minute cancellations or guest no-shows on the departure date.
  • Partial utilization or voluntary abandonment of booked tour components.
  • Cancellations arising from personal emergencies, illness, or missed flight connections not covered under provider waivers.
  • Special discounted, promotional tariffs, or peak holiday season bookings (December–January, festival weeks).
  • Visa rejections, passport expiry, or missing government documentation.
05

Refund Processing Timeline & Method

Step 1
Written Request

Customer sends written cancellation with booking ID.

Step 2
Vendor Audit

Audit of hotel, flight, and transport cancellation recovery.

Step 3
7–14 Days Credit

Approved refunds credited to the original payment source.

Note: Wonderer South India is not liable for intermediate banking delays or international card processing holidays.

06

Amendments & Tour Rescheduling

  • Date changes and itinerary adjustments are subject to room availability, vehicle scheduling, and provider fee structures.
  • Rescheduling requests must be placed in writing at least 48 hours prior to the scheduled departure.
  • Any seasonal tariff difference or carrier rebooking penalty must be borne directly by the customer.
07

Force Majeure & Unforeseen Events

Wonderer South India shall not be held liable for monetary compensation or refund penalties arising from events beyond human control (Force Majeure), including:

  • Severe weather disruptions, floods, earthquakes, or natural disasters.
  • Sudden government travel restrictions, road closures, or curfew orders.
  • Public health emergencies or pandemics.
  • Civil disturbances, riots, or public transport strikes.

In all such scenarios, we work tirelessly with partners to secure future travel credits wherever allowable.

08

Cancellations Initiated by Wonderer South India

In rare operational circumstances where Wonderer South India must cancel a scheduled tour, guests will be promptly offered:

Option A 100% Full Refund of all monies paid directly to Wonderer South India.
Option B Alternative Tour Package of equivalent value with upgraded amenities.
09

Mode of Communication & Policy Updates

Official Channels: All refund and cancellation claims must occur through official email or website communication channels. Verbal or unverified chat requests cannot be honored.

Updates: Wonderer South India reserves the right to modify this Refund & Cancellation Policy at any time without prior notice. Updated terms take effect immediately upon publication.

10

Refund Inquiries & Support Helpdesk

For urgent cancellation requests or refund status tracking, please contact our helpdesk:

📞 Priority Helpline: +91 80725 66010 / +91 98402 91110

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.subtitle: Our commitment to safeguarding your personal information, data confidentiality, and user rights at Tramax Tours.
pages.content:
At Wonderer South India, we are committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information.

This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our website or use our services.

01

Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information when you interact with our platform:

👤 Personal Information

  • Full Name: For identification and reservation vouchers.
  • Email Address: For sending booking confirmations, itineraries, and receipts.
  • Phone Number: For real-time trip coordination and chauffeur communication.
  • Travel Preferences & Enquiries: Destination preferences, group size, and custom tour requests.
  • Identification Details: Government-issued ID, Passport, or Visa info (only when strictly required for monument passes or flight/train reservations).

💻 Non-Personal & Technical Information

  • Browser type, operating system, and screen resolution.
  • Device information and approximate geographic location.
  • IP address and anonymous analytical identifiers.
  • Website usage data (pages visited, time spent, interaction timestamps).
02

How We Use Your Information

The information we collect is used purposefully to deliver seamless travel experiences:

  • Respond promptly to enquiries and customize your private itineraries.
  • Process reservations, hotel bookings, transportation, and payments.
  • Continuously improve our website performance, service quality, and guest experience.
  • Communicate itinerary updates, trip reminders, seasonal offers, or critical travel advisories.
  • Comply with applicable tourism regulations, taxation, and legal requirements.
03

Sharing of Information

🛡️ Strict Privacy Promise: We NEVER sell, trade, rent, or lease your personal data to any third-party marketing companies.

We share your information strictly on a need-to-know basis with:

  • Verified Travel Partners: Hotels, airlines, chauffeur teams, and licensed tour guides for executing confirmed bookings.
  • Regulatory & Government Authorities: When mandatory under applicable Indian or international law.
  • Trusted Service Providers: Secure payment gateways, SMS/Email dispatchers who assist our operational infrastructure under non-disclosure agreements.
04

Data Security

We implement enterprise-grade technical and organizational security measures (including TLS/SSL encryption, restricted access protocols, and firewall protections) to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, or disclosure.

Note: While we adhere to top industry standards, no method of digital transmission or storage is 100% impenetrable. We constantly audit our systems to ensure safety.

05

Cookies Policy

Our website utilizes secure cookies to:

  • Enhance user browsing experience and maintain session continuity.
  • Analyze aggregated traffic patterns to optimize page speed and navigation.
  • Remember your selected language and currency preferences.

You can choose to disable cookies through your browser settings, though certain interactive features may experience limitations.

06

Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party portals (such as external flight aggregators or tourism boards). Wonderer South India is not responsible for the privacy practices, policies, or content of such external websites. We encourage you to review their terms upon departure.

07

User Rights

You retain full control over your personal data. You have the right to:

  • Access: Request a copy of the personal data we hold about you.
  • Rectification: Request correction of inaccurate, outdated, or incomplete data.
  • Erasure / Deletion: Request deletion of your personal records, subject to statutory accounting requirements.
  • Withdraw Consent: Opt-out from promotional communications at any time.

Requests can be submitted directly via our Contact Us page or official email.

08

Data Retention & Children's Privacy

Data Retention: We retain personal information only for as long as necessary to fulfill the trip execution, billing, dispute resolution, or as required by law.

Children's Privacy: Our website services are not directed toward unaccompanied individuals under the age of 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information directly from children without parental or guardian consent.

09

Changes to This Policy & Consent

Wonderer South India reserves the right to update or modify this Privacy Policy at any time. Any changes will be published directly on this page with an updated revision timestamp.

By using our website or submitting your information for bookings or inquiries, you expressly consent to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

10

Privacy Officer & Contact Information

If you have any questions, concerns, or data requests regarding this Privacy Policy, please reach out to our privacy desk:

📧 Privacy Desk: privacy@tramaxtours.in / contact@tramaxtours.in
📞 Telephone: +91 80725 66010 / +91 98402 91110
📍 Address: Wonderer South India Head Office, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India

reviews.title: Unforgettable South India Odyssey
reviews.content: Exploring Kerala and Tamil Nadu with a private chauffeur from Wanderer South India was the best decision we made. Our driver was polite, extremely knowledgeable about temple history, and the car was spotless every morning. Total peace of mind!

reviews.title: Magnificent Heritage & Shore Temples
reviews.content: The Mahabalipuram and Kanchipuram day tours were breathtaking! The rock relief carvings and seaside Shore Temple were brought to life by our private guide. The Pay on Arrival booking option was super smooth and reassuring.

reviews.title: Mystical Palm Leaf Horoscope Experience
reviews.content: We booked the sacred Palm Leaf Nadi Horoscope reading and temple tour in Vaitheeswaran Kovil. Finding my ancient leaf from thumbprint was an astonishing and deeply spiritual revelation. Superbly organized!

reviews.title: First-Class Chauffeur & Tea Gardens
reviews.content: Munnar mist heights and Alleppey houseboats were paradise. Wanderer South India took care of every single transfer with luxury AC vehicles. Excellent English communication and prompt WhatsApp updates throughout.

reviews.title: Incredible Waves at Covelong Point
reviews.content: Surfing Covelong waves was the highlight of my trip to Tamil Nadu! Certified ocean instructors made me catch my first clean wave in under 45 minutes. Safe, exhilarating, and highly recommended!

reviews.title: Golden Chidambaram & Thanjavur Circuit
reviews.content: Brought my elderly parents for a temple pilgrimage across Thanjavur Big Temple and Madurai Meenakshi. The chauffeur was extraordinarily attentive, patient, and handled luggage effortlessly. A 5-star experience!
